question: Padma shri Ananda Shankar Jayant, is renowned for her significant contributions to which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ananda Shankar Jayant**

 
 
• **Ananda Shankar Jayant** is a **Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi dance expert** from India who also works as a **choreographer, scholar, and bureaucrat**. 
 
• She is the **first female officer in the South Central Railway's Indian Railway Traffic Service**, and her 2009 TED presentation was named one of the top twelve most incredible TED talks on cancer.
 
• She received the **2009 Sangeet Natak Akademi Award** for her contributions to the **Bharatnatyam dancing style**.
 
• Additionally, she was given the **Kalaimamani Award by the Tamil Nadu government and the Kala Ratna Award by the Andhra Pradesh government**.
 
• For her contributions to the arts, the **Government of India presented her with the fourth-highest civilian honour, the Padma Shri, in 2007**.
